name: Tenmaku no Jādūgaru
overview: United by a desire for revenge, two women unleash a storm upon the most powerful empire in the world. Torn from her hometown after the loss of her mother, Sitara enters the service of Lady Fatima, the wife of a scholar. Her new master’s son, Mohammed, teaches her the power and importance of knowledge. But one day, her new city is swept away by the mighty Mongol Empire led by Genghis Khan.
